name: Hero lockup
summary: One hero word at the widest size the frame allows, stacked over two small, quiet rows, behind the head. A long word is held to the width of the frame.
use_when: a short, punchy clip with a hook or a payoff that has to hit, and room above the crown
never_when: a long explainer, where giant words on every phrase tire the eye, or a tight frame with no room above the crown
